brief_item.title: CodeNib: 服务编码Agent的多视图仓库上下文系统
brief_item.core_conclusion: 编码Agent反复搜索导航仓库但索引、语言服务器与任务历史彼此割裂，无法区分精确替换与质量代价。CodeNib以数据系统视角把commit视为不可变基线数据，派生词法/稠密/结构化视图，为每次操作显式标注有效性边界。
brief_item.mechanism: commit为基线，派生词法(BM25/Zoekt)、稠密(FAISS嵌入)与结构化(符号图)视图；增量维护用Git/LSP辅助符号级图修复与内容寻址向量复用；Agent交付为排序计划(词法/语义/混合/结构)加有界上下文策略(grep/read、eager注入、eager+compact)。
brief_item.result: 增量图修复中位数8.67倍加速、向量复用25.44倍(仅输出匹配的转换，图45.5%/向量90.3%)；静态导航匹配子集相对live LSP中位数4.72倍低时延(定义匹配87%、引用39%)；上下文策略跨5模型以50-87%更少trajectory token保持定位；共享驻留6.24 vs 13.20 s/session。
brief_item.boundary: 仅评估仓库交互与定位，未评补丁生成/issue解决；图修复仅45.5%源变更转换严格匹配(Rust/TS-JS为0/9)；静态导航references匹配22-73%；每查询-策略-模型仅单次轨迹。
brief_item.project_relevance: [项目判断]直接回答问题2(知识图/索引是否降端到端时延)：增量图修复对Go/Python有效但对Rust/TS失败；静态导航可替定义查询但非引用查询，需保留live回退；上下文注入可降token 50-87%。检索/导航/交付的严格分离为对比CodeGraph/RepoGraph提供清晰架构。

facts.title: CodeNib: A Multi-View Data System for Serving Repository Context to Coding Agents
facts.event_hint: CodeNib: multi-view (lexical/dense/structural) repository context serving system with incremental maintenance
facts.problem: Coding agents repeatedly search, navigate, and retain context from evolving repositories, but disconnected indexes, language servers, and task-local histories force repeated discovery and obscure lifecycle costs. Prior systems either materialize code facts, expose live semantic tools, or construct ranked/structural context — but do not compose these capabilities with explicit per-operation validity boundaries, making it impossible to distinguish exact substitutions from quality-cost tradeoffs.
facts.mechanism: CodeNib takes a data-systems view: a commit is immutable base data; chunks, postings, embeddings, occurrences, and relationships are derived views; agent requests are view-specific queries; prompt context is a bounded delivery result. Three coupled challenges: C1 Heterogeneous views — lexical (BM25, Zoekt trigram), dense (FAISS embeddings of L0 files or L2 callables), and structural (symbol graph with contain/reference/import/type-use edges) views have different physical layouts but results map to repository-relative source ranges. C2 Incremental freshness — Git/LSP-assisted graph repair (symbol-level: classifies symbols as deleted/affected/shifted/unchanged/added, preserves stable facts, reconnects edit-invalidated edges) and content-addressed vector reuse (re-embeds only changed content). C3 Agent delivery — ranked plans (routes A-D: lexical/semantic/hybrid/structural), static/live navigation providers, and bounded context policies (grep/read, eager L2 injection, eager+compact one-time rewrite). A manifest Mc catalogs each artifact's commit, profile, status, and capabilities. The runtime loads only required views, never builds online. MCP adapter and bound skills expose operations to the agent loop.

evidence.claim: Incremental maintenance: graph symbol repair matches independent rebuilds on 15/33 source-changing transitions with median 8.67x speedup; vector content-addressed reuse matches on 28/31 transitions with median 25.44x speedup
evidence.source_locator: Figure 10(a) and Section 9.5 'Q4: Incremental View Maintenance'
evidence.value: 8.67x median graph speedup (15/33 matching); 25.44x median vector speedup (28/31 matching)
evidence.baseline: Independent fresh rebuild of the same commit transition
evidence.condition: 5 first-parent commit transitions per repo, 8 repos across Go/Python/Rust/TS-JS; speedups reported ONLY for transitions where output matches independent rebuild (graph: 45.5% of transitions; vector: 90.3%)

evidence.claim: Static navigation reproduces live LSP normalized path/start-line sets on 63.2% of 1,000 requests (87.4% definitions, 39.0% references); on matching subset, median live/static latency ratio is 4.72x
evidence.source_locator: Figure 9 and Section 9.4 'Q3: Static versus Live Symbol Compatibility'
evidence.value: 4.72x median live/static latency ratio on 632 matching requests
evidence.baseline: Live JSON-RPC LSP providers (clangd, gopls, basedpyright, rust-analyzer, typescript-language-server)
evidence.condition: 100 snapshots, 5 language groups; static provider is lossless ONLY under matched location projection; definitions match 80-99%, references match 22-73% across languages

evidence.claim: Context delivery policies across 5 agent models preserve localization margin (lower bound of paired 95% CI >= -0.05 AnswerRecall@5) with 50-87% fewer trajectory tokens than paired grep/read
evidence.source_locator: Figure 11 and Section 9.7 'Q5: Agent Context Delivery'
evidence.value: 12.9-49.9% of grep/read tokens across 5 models (i.e., 50.1-87.1% fewer)
evidence.baseline: Model-directed grep/read with no injected candidates
evidence.condition: 7,500 core trajectories (2,500 query-model cells x 3 policies); frozen top-10 L2 embedding candidates; one trajectory per query-policy-model; 16-turn cap

evidence.claim: Dense retrieval file Recall@10 rises from 0.705 to 0.820 across embedding families; pointwise reranking adds up to 4.6pp at 46.6x latency cost
evidence.condition: 100 CodeNib Base snapshots; k=10; k' in {30,50,100}; reranking requires seconds vs sub-300ms for dense query

evidence.claim: Lifecycle accounting: materialization B=116.7s, fresh-process view loading L=7.40s, warm serve trace S=0.727s per 20 sessions; at reuse scale q=20, projected 13.20 vs 6.24 s/session for process-isolated vs shared-resident
evidence.condition: 25 snapshots, 42 requests per snapshot; projections from measured B, L, S terms; connected points are accounting projections not executed scales

facts.evaluation_context: Two datasets: CodeNib Base (100 snapshots from 25 repos across C/C++, Go, Python, Rust, TS/JS, drawn from SWE-bench Verified + Multilingual) and CodeNib Synthesis (500 rows, 25 snapshots, 20 queries each). Five agent models: Claude Haiku 4.5, Qwen3.5-9B/27B, Gemma 4-12B-IT (vLLM), Gemini 2.5 Flash (Vertex AI). Embeddings: SweRank-Small(137M)/Large(7B), Qwen3-Embed-0.6B/4B, Jina-Code-1.5B. Rerankers: Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B/4B/8B. Hardware: 1 NVIDIA H100 PCIe (80GB), 2 Intel Xeon Gold 5416S. FAISS Flat/IVF/HNSW. BM25 + optional Zoekt. MCP stdio adapter. 14 languages chunked, 5 languages with full semantic backends.
facts.limitations: Does NOT evaluate patch generation or issue resolution — only repository interaction and localization. MCP is not an experimental factor. No concurrent publication, learned online scheduling, or post-training evaluation. Graph repair matches only 45.5% of source-changing transitions (Rust/TS-JS pass 0/9 and 0/9 respectively despite high F1, because strict exact-match checks expose live-provider non-determinism). Graph expansion effect is statistically unresolved (all confidence intervals include zero). BM25 has no integrated delta update. Static navigation does not reproduce all live responses (references match rate 22-73%). Single trajectory per query-policy-model (intervals measure snapshot variation, not repeated model sampling). Provider model IDs for Haiku/Qwen are aliases, not immutable revisions — provider-time drift unresolved. Does not estimate production arrival rates or concurrent update throughput.
facts.project_relevance: Directly addresses project question 2 (whether code knowledge graphs / repository indexing truly reduce end-to-end task latency). The multi-view approach with explicit operation-specific validity boundaries is the most rigorous treatment found of the lifecycle costs of repository context systems. Key findings for the briefing: (1) incremental graph repair works well for Go/Python (100% exact match) but fails for Rust/TS — language coverage matters. (2) Static navigation can replace live LSP for definitions (87% match, 4.7x faster) but NOT for references (39% match) — deployment must retain live fallback. (3) Context injection (eager/compact) can cut trajectory tokens 50-87% while preserving localization — directly relevant to 'token消耗' metric. (4) The strict separation of retrieval (ranked candidates) from navigation (source locations) from delivery (bounded context) provides a clean architecture for comparing with CodeGraph, RepoGraph, etc. The data-systems framing (commit = base data, views = derived data, manifest = catalog) could inform inference-network context serving beyond code.
